items.title: We Have a LOT of Work to Do... | Space Engineers 2 Survival #1
items.description: Welcome to my Space Engineers 2 Survival series! We're starting from the beginning and building our way from a small start into a fully operational spacefaring operation. Along the way, we'll explore the planets and asteroids, gather resources, build and upgrade our ships and bases, automate production, and see just how far we can push what we can create.
